measurement_scope: relational write surface (secondary index, unique constraint, foreign key, SQL INSERT/UPDATE via C API, 2-document SQL transaction), 1 and 8 writers, before the transaction-resolution staging fix (opts.transaction_resolution still waits for durability under the apply lock -- see lite-single-commit-write-path.md section 3.2/3.2a)
known_limitations: Every relational/transaction commit site still attributes to the "other" stage bucket: this pass did not add per-site write_amplification_trace stage tags (relational_index/relational_integrity/txn_resolve) the way text/graph/dense/sparse already have. durable_commits_per_write and syncs/update are accurate; the stage breakdown is not yet attributed.

mean_primary_group_size reads 0.000 for every relational mode because none of these commits go through the primary_commit-tagged Txn.commit path; group-commit bundling cannot be read off this field for relational writes yet.
